WITH product_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    pc.product_type_description,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) as order_item_count,
    AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS DECIMAL)) as avg_quantity
  FROM Products p
  JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code
  LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description
),
total_items AS (
  SELECT SUM(order_item_count) as total
  FROM product_stats
),
product_with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.product_type_description,
    ps.avg_quantity,
    CAST(ps.order_item_count AS DECIMAL) as order_item_count,
    CAST(ps.order_item_count AS DECIMAL) / (SELECT total FROM total_items) as share
  FROM product_stats ps
),
type_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    product_type_description,
    AVG(avg_quantity) as avg_avg_quantity,
    AVG(order_item_count) as avg_order_item_count,
    AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM product_with_share
  GROUP BY product_type_description
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_avg_quantity) as final_avg_quantity,
  AVG(avg_order_item_count) as final_avg_order_item_count,
  AVG(avg_share) as final_avg_share
FROM type_averages
